title: Tidy tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests: HF-009
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

Move the remaining SynchronousIoCancel.Created set/reset sites to Scans.WithGuard: CancellationTests.cs:80/203/258, CancelledFolderTests.cs:239/254 (A995WindowsReturnsWithNoCancelIsAnUnreadableFolderAndTheScanCarriesOn), StalledShareTests.cs:54, CloudPlaceholderTests.cs:374, CloudRigTests.cs:192/237 and TopLevelRowTextTests.cs:70. Each site that does it by hand is another place a missed reset can leak the [ThreadStatic] seam into a later test on the same thread.
